segments.comment: Variation of sensing-vision-order-remembered-unseen-jackals with another seed and room: six tame violet fungi, two peaceful baby gold dragons and three fog clouds. A fungus beside the hero attacks a fog cloud in the dark ('The violet fungus misses it.'), leaving a remembered unseen monster, and a baby gold dragon ends the same turn next to that square. allmain.c moveloop_core() (454-471) runs see_monsters() before vision_recalc(), so the screen after that turn shows the fog cloud as 'v' two squares east of the hero rather than its gas region's '#'.
